about: What makes one creature other than the rest of its kind, along one axis each: how old it is, how big, what part it has among its kind, the country it was bred in, how it is disposed, what has got into it. A creature is its species with any of these laid over it, one at most of each axis (Variant elder. Variant great. in a Person), never a species of its own for each (the owner, 4 November night). Each says the word it is called by before its kind (an old great rat), what is seen of it, and what it adds: to its qualities, its health at each level, its abilities and its natural traits (data/catalog/traits.json). kinds: the kinds of creature it can be (animal, monster, spirit). hint: a Deem condition on where it is met, by which a generated country lays it on what dens there (climate: arid, cold, humid, temperate, tropical; habitat: the kind of country, as RegionEcology names it); one without a hint is only ever an author's.

young.says: not yet grown: quick, unsure of itself, and readier to run

elder.says: grey and scarred, the one the others make way for, and the last to run

runt.says: small for its kind, and the quicker for it

great.says: twice the size of the rest of its kind

brood_mother.says: swollen and slow, keeping to her eggs and not leaving them

pack_leader.says: the one the rest follow, and watch

frost.says: thick-coated and pale, bred where the winters are long

marsh.says: dark and slick with the mud of the fens it was bred in

sunburnt.says: lean and dun-coloured, bred where the sun is hard

starving.says: ribs showing; it will not wait to be sure of you

blighted.says: something has got into it: patchy, weeping, and wrong in the way it moves
